# GameScene Refactor Plan

*Generated by code-architect agent, 2026-04-18.*

## TL;DR

`apps/game/src/scenes/GameScene.ts` is 2,979 LOC. The original plan was to split it into
CorridorScene / RoomScene / GardenScene. **The architect recommends against this**, because:

- Needs-tick timer, spawn timer, conflict system, and badge checks must run continuously
  regardless of which view is shown. Phaser sleeping scenes pause their `time` manager.
- Corridor → Room transitions are ~100ms re-renders. Paying Phaser scene start/shutdown
  cost (camera fade, asset re-bind, input re-register) for what's currently
  `this.viewMode = 'room'; this.renderView()` would degrade the child UX.
- Adding more scenes multiplies `onComplete` callback coupling with no real benefit.

Instead: **extract a `GameStateStore` module plus per-view rendering modules, and leave
GameScene as a thin ~350-LOC coordinator** that owns timers and delegates rendering.

## Target Structure

```
apps/game/src/
├── scenes/
│   ├── GameScene.ts              (was 2,979 → target ~350 LOC)
│   └── … (other scenes unchanged)
├── game-state/
│   ├── GameStateStore.ts         (~150 LOC)
│   ├── loadSaveState.ts          (~90 LOC)
│   └── index.ts                  (re-exports)
└── game-views/
    ├── CorridorView.ts           (~350)
    ├── RoomView.ts               (~500)
    ├── KitchenView.ts            (~200)
    ├── GardenView.ts             (~200)
    ├── HUDView.ts                (~200)
    ├── NavBarView.ts             (~180)
    ├── AnimalDetailsPopup.ts     (~350)
    ├── ConflictView.ts           (~220)
    ├── CollarPickerView.ts       (~160)
    └── CelebrationViews.ts       (~180)
```

## Migration Order (8 phases, 20–29 hours total)

| Phase | Work | Hours |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Prep, tsconfig aliases, smoke-check checklist | 1 |
| 1 | Extract `GameStateStore` + `loadSaveState` — foundation, no visible change | 4–6 |
| 2 | Extract `GardenView` (smallest, fewest interactions) | 1–2 |
| 3 | Extract `KitchenView` | 1–2 |
| 4 | Extract modal views (Celebrations, Conflict, CollarPicker) | 3–4 |
| 5 | Extract `AnimalDetailsPopup` (largest popup) | 3–4 |
| 6 | Extract `HUDView` + `NavBarView` | 2–3 |
| 7 | Extract `CorridorView` + `RoomView` (scroll state migration is the tricky part) | 4–5 |
| 8 | Final tidy — dead-code sweep, typecheck clean | 1–2 |

Each phase leaves the game fully playable, so no feature freeze is required. Suggested
cadence: one extraction + one smoke-test per session, review between phases.

## Key Design Decisions

- **GameStateStore is NOT a singleton.** Instantiated once by `GameScene.create()` and passed
  explicitly to view modules. Keeps tests trivial (construct with fixtures, assert result).
- **View modules are plain functions**, not classes. Signature:
  `render<View>(scene, store, container, callbacks) → void`. Callbacks handle state mutations
  so views stay stateless.
- **Timers stay in GameScene** — the needs ticker and spawn timer are scene lifecycle
  concerns, not view concerns. They mutate the store and decide whether to re-render.
- **Rejected: `game.registry`** — global bag of any-typed values with no reactivity, no type
  safety, no clear ownership. Every read creates hidden coupling. Store module wins.

## Top Risks

1. **Tween/timer leaks on view re-render.** `clearView()` destroys container objects but
   tweens targeting them don't auto-remove. Latent bug already. Each view needs its own
   tween group.
2. **`onComplete` callbacks capturing stale scene state.** After `scene.restart()` (resize
   handler), old closures hold stale `this.animals`. Moving to store makes closures capture
   `this.store` — a stable reference that survives restarts. This is the primary
   correctness win from the store extraction alone.
3. **Scroll state (`scrollY`, `isDragging`) migration.** Currently GameScene instance
   fields; conceptually belong to RoomView. Phase 7 — pass a ref object.
4. **`scene.restart()` re-runs `create()` and re-constructs the store.** Check
   `registry.get('gameStore')` first; reuse if present. Await `saveState` before restart.

## Smoke-Check Checklist

Run after each phase:
- [ ] Load game, see corridor
- [ ] Welcome an arriving animal
- [ ] Feed / play / groom / heal
- [ ] Bond an animal to pet (triggers collar picker)
- [ ] Walk a pet (WalkScene round-trip, state returned)
- [ ] Depot session (DepotScene round-trip)
- [ ] Trigger a conflict, resolve it
- [ ] Trigger a level-up, celebration plays
- [ ] Close tab, reopen — state persists
